metadata.description: Printable Map needed to play. It’s Halloween night, and five friendly monsters are hiding in the neighborhood! Using the printable Trick-or-Treat Map, kids explore spooky houses, look for clues and try to find the monsters for Sheriff Spook! A perfect Halloween audio adventure for ages 5–10.
